about: The Postcommunion of the feast of the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus. It asks that the holy gifts kindle divine fervor and teach the faithful to despise earthly things and love heavenly ones.

seg.tr: May Thy holy gifts, O Lord Jesus, bestow divine fervor upon us, so that, having tasted the sweetness of Thy most sweet Heart, we may learn to despise earthly things and love heavenly things. Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
